item: Read aging_data.csv to understand the dataset structure
Calculate descriptive statistics for UTS and elongation (count, mean, min, max) and write them to descriptive_stats.md
Analyze the relationship between UTS and temperature to identify peak conditions and check for monotonicity, specifically focusing on the 620C/4h row, and flag any anomalies in anomalies.md

Write analysis.py to load the data, generate plots for UTS vs temperature and elongation vs temperature, save them as fig_strength.png and fig_elongation.png, and print peak/valley conditions to stdout
Execute analysis.py and verify the existence and size of fig_strength.png and fig_elongation.png
Write analysis.md, summarizing the trends, the strength-ductility trade-off, the discussion on the 620C anomaly (measurement error vs. real effect), and one actionable recommendation
Ensure analysis.md includes at least three concrete numbers extracted from the data
Verify all generated artifacts (descriptive_stats.md, anomalies.md, analysis.py, analysis.md, fig_strength.png, fig_elongation.png) exist and report their sizes
Call finish with a short summary of the analysis
